units.policy: Finding information on your topic is permitted with generative AI tools under the default guidelines.
units.why: "Finding information on your topic" is a listed permitted use. P104 (finding sources) is nearest, though it does not mention verifying them.
units.fit_note: Finding information generally, with no condition to read and verify sources.

units.passage: Possibilities include topic brainstorming, search assistance, source evaluation, and summaries and source documentation.
units.policy: Possibilities for AI use in research include topic brainstorming, search assistance, source evaluation, and summaries and source documentation.
units.why: Lists research uses of AI (search assistance, source evaluation, summaries) as possibilities, which is the literature-and-sources permission P104.

units.passage: AI Research tools: We will explore ResearchRabbit, SemanticScholar, AI research assistants in e-books, and other appropriate AI research tools to explore how AI can help you find additional sources that you can use in your exploration of our course topics.
units.why: The course will use AI research tools 'to find additional sources'; AI for literature search (P104).
"Support literature exploration or summary" is a permitted research use of AI, so P104.

units.passage: Support finding or searching for resources, information, research etc. (research partner)
units.policy: When appropriate for context and discipline, GenAI might be used to support finding or searching for resources, information, research etc.
units.why: "Support finding or searching for resources, information, research etc. (research partner)" permits source finding, P104.

units.passage: They can help you during the research process, such as with identifying useful keywords to find relevant information on a topic.
units.why: AI can help 'identifying useful keywords to find relevant information on a topic': AI for research and finding sources, nearest P104 though it covers keyword search only.
units.fit_note: Names keyword generation for research, not finding or screening sources. | Other coder: Keyword identification for finding sources; not source screening or reading.

units.why: 'Researching topics' is a listed permitted purpose; AI may help find information, P104 (literature search and sources), partly since no verification condition is given.
units.fit_note: Says 'researching topics' only; no condition to read or verify sources. Researching topics generally, with no source-verification condition.

units.passage: If you use AI tools to search for sources, verify that they are legitimate and that they are right for your research.
units.why: 'If you use AI tools to search for sources, verify that they are legitimate' allows AI source-finding on condition that students verify the sources, which is P104.
units.fit_note: Conditions AI-assisted source search on verification; does not explicitly grant permission.

units.passage: Summarize research and generate bibliographies to assist with literature reviews
units.why: 'Summarize research and generate bibliographies to assist with literature reviews' is AI for finding and handling sources (P104).
units.fit_note: Listed as a use case with no condition to verify sources.
